title: Execution Capsule EC4 mutation dispatch and EC5 rollout governance

phases.objective: Prove the complete default-off synthetic mutation-dispatch-to-rollout-readback journey without granting runtime or Production authority.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Execution Capsule mutation dispatch integration boundary
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A reversible mutation dispatch is accepted only with complete current evidence, and rollout or legacy retirement remains gated by exact approval, executor readback, and rollback evidence.
steps: Build an immutable Execution Capsule and reversible mutation operation contract
Refresh and bind approval, capability, authority, resource, provider, connection, and expected-SHA evidence
Project a secret-safe dispatch envelope and execute the bounded synthetic mutation adapter
Evaluate rollout and legacy-retirement readiness with exact executor readback and rollback controls
assertions: Incomplete, stale, mismatched, substituted, or secret-like evidence fails closed
Dispatch input remains bound to the exact tenant, workspace, brand, resource, connection, and expected SHA
Readiness evaluation cannot retire a legacy resolver or grant runtime authority automatically
The synthetic journey returns bounded readback and rollback evidence

phases.objective: Mount the governed boundaries with durable operational controls after separate authorization.
Certify fault injection, unknown-outcome reconciliation, and recovery under mounted runtime conditions.
Run the same journey against an authorized live non-production target.
Verify exact Production SHA and runtime readback under separate release authorization.
